t: You're looking at the Dolphin Sundial, a sundial at the Royal Observatory in Greenwich. Two people made it. Edwin Russell, who lived from 1939 to 2013, was an English sculptor. He was born in Heathfield in Sussex and studied at the Brighton School of Art and the Royal Academy School. Christopher Daniel, who lived from 1933 to 2022, was a British sundial designer. A sculptor and a sundial designer worked together on this piece, so it is both a timekeeper and a work of craft.
